title: Free and prepaid allowance pools: owner decision to use them every period
evidence_status: owner assertion; no gate sample, board or matched evaluation backs adequacy
statement: we are failing to utilize free deepseek and antigravity consistently

scope.work: bounded work with a deterministic check: tests, repros, fixture refreshes, docs checks, and first-pass reviews
scope.inputs: DeepSeek free: public only. Antigravity: any repository content except credential or signing work (--sensitive refuses) and the prohibited inputs in the declaration.
scope.review: Output from these arms gets a different-vendor check before merge. A first-pass review is advisory.

pools.deepseek_free: daily cap that resets at 00:00 UTC
pools.antigravity_claude_gpt: separate weekly cap, prepaid, idle at 0% on 2026-11-05

observed_limit.antigravity_message: Usage Limit Reached... resets in N days
observed_limit.deepseek_message: Free usage limit reached. Connect a provider or subscribe to OpenCode Go to keep going, or switch models.
observed_limit.handling: A launch that fails with the pool's limit message marks the pool exhausted until its known reset; route falls through to the next arm.
